title: Reject non-PDF uploads before parsing
preconditions: The FastAPI service is running and the doctor check passes.
A synthetic text file and a file with a .pdf name but no PDF signature are available.

steps.expected: 415 with a detail saying only PDF uploads are supported.

steps.action: POST the same endpoint with a .pdf filename whose content is not a PDF.
steps.expected: 415 with a detail about the missing PDF signature.

risk: Use synthetic files only. Never upload a real candidate PDF.
